name: Warm serif headline types on, phone close behind
looks: On a soft peach gradient, a two-line serif headline types on with a blinking cursor, its last word switching to a loose cursive script with a hand-drawn underline swash. It cuts to a phone held close and centred, a small notification card popping up over a blurred message thread behind it.
build: script-accent-underline for the headline. The phone is a static or barely-drifting device frame; the notification card scales/fades in (0.9->1, power3.out) over the backgrounded thread, which stays soft-focus throughout.
sound: A soft typewriter clack per character and a pen swish under the underline, then a light pop as the notification card lands.
prompt: Open warm, not corporate: type on a short serif headline with one word switching to a cursive script and a hand-drawn underline, then cut to a phone held close with a single real notification popping up over a softly blurred thread behind it.
